difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the composite of two continuous functors which induce morphisms of sites is again continuous and induces a morphism of sites (statement lines 2980-2991). The proof is a complete argument: continuity is immediate from the definitions (proof line 2994); the functors on presheaves compose, so their sheafifications do, and since the functor induced by the composite and the composite of the induced functors are left adjoint to the same functor they agree by uniqueness of adjoints (proof lines 2995-2997); exactness then follows as exactness of a composite of exact functors (proof lines 2998-2999). The non-formal content is the identification of the induced functors. The claim is H1: a short argument with each input named.
